senses.gloss: f. (פנה, v. פנים; cmp. אַפּוּתָא fr. אַף) upper, (front), a kind of legging connected with a shoe or sole over which straps are drawn for fastening; corresp. to h. מַנְעַל.
units: Taan. 12ᵇ מסיימי א׳ (Ms. M. פַּנְתָּאֵי pl.) having put on appantas (on a public fast-day).

<cite ref="Yevamot 102a:11">Yeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה ליה א׳ מֵעַל וכ׳</he> (ed. <cite ref="Q00001"><he>פ׳</he></cite>; v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v.) the panta is one ‘from on’ (referring to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:9">Deut. XXV, 9</cite> ‘and she shall strip his shoe from on his foot’), and the thong a ‘from on’ of a ‘from on’, i.e. panta and thong are two coverings.
<cite ref="Berakhot 43b:14">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא אמרו אלא בא׳</he> (ed. <he>בפ׳</he>) this applies only to the panta (upper).
